_about: 내 데이터로 LLM 파인튜닝하기 7장 사양표. 모든 값은 각 항목의 url을 checked 날짜에 직접 읽고 옮겼다. 값이 바뀌면 이 파일을 고치지 말고 날짜가 다른 새 파일을 만든다. 1GB = 10^9바이트로 센다.

model.name: Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B
model.role: 5장과 같은 예시 모델. 추천이나 순위가 아니다.

lora_paper.title: LoRA: Low-Rank Adaptation of Large Language Models
lora_paper.eq3: h = W0 x + ΔW x = W0 x + BAx
lora_paper.shapes: W0 ∈ R^{d×k}, B ∈ R^{d×r}, A ∈ R^{r×k}, r ≪ min(d, k)
lora_paper.init: We use a random Gaussian initialization for A and zero for B, so ΔW = BA is zero at the beginning of training.
lora_paper.scaling: We then scale ΔW x by α/r, where α is a constant in r. When optimizing with Adam, tuning α is roughly the same as tuning the learning rate if we scale the initialization appropriately. As a result, we simply set α to the first r we try and do not tune it.
lora_paper.sec4_2: We limit our study to only adapting the attention weights for downstream tasks and freeze the MLP modules
lora_paper.gpt3: On GPT-3 175B, we reduce the VRAM consumption during training from 1.2TB to 350GB. With r = 4 and only the query and value projection matrices being adapted, the checkpoint size is reduced by roughly 10,000× (from 350GB to 35MB)
lora_paper.abstract: LoRA can reduce the number of trainable parameters by 10,000 times and the GPU memory requirement by 3 times.
lora_paper.table6_note: a rank as small as one suffices for adapting both Wq and Wv on these datasets while training Wq alone needs a larger r.

qlora_paper.title: QLoRA: Efficient Finetuning of Quantized LLMs
qlora_paper.abstract: (a) 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4) ... (b) Double Quantization ... and (c) Paged Optimizers to manage memory spikes.
qlora_paper.compute_dtype: whenever a QLoRA weight tensor is used, we dequantize the tensor to BFloat16, and then perform a matrix multiplication in 16-bit.
qlora_paper.lora_grads_bf16: we only compute weight gradients for the LoRA parameters which use 16-bit BrainFloat.
qlora_paper.paged: We use this feature to allocate paged memory for the optimizer states which are then automatically evicted to CPU RAM when the GPU runs out-of-memory and paged back into GPU memory when the memory is needed in the optimizer update step.
qlora_paper.paged_no_measure: we do not provide hard measurements for Paged Optimizers since the paging only occurs when processing mini-batches with long sequence lengths, which is rare.
qlora_paper.all_linear: LoRA on all linear transformer block layers are required to match full finetuning performance.
qlora_paper.appendix_B2_hparams: We set LoRA r = 64, α = 16, and add LoRA modules on all linear layers of the base model. ... LoRA dropout of 0.1 for models up to 13B and 0.05 for 33B and 65B models.
qlora_paper.appendix_A_lora_dropout: We find that LoRA dropout 0.05 is useful for small models (7B, 13B), but not for larger models (33B, 65B). We find LoRA r is unrelated to final performance if LoRA is used on all layers
qlora_paper.note_dropout: 부록 A(0.05가 7B·13B에 유용)와 부록 B.2(13B 이하에 0.1 사용)가 서로 다른 값을 적는다.

peft.all_linear: all linear/Conv1D modules are chosen (if the model is a PreTrainedModel, the output layer excluded)
peft.init_docs: By default, PEFT initializes LoRA weights with Kaiming-uniform for weight A and zeros for weight B resulting in an identity transform
peft.docs_qlora_style: To apply LoRA to all the linear layers, like in QLoRA, set target_modules="all-linear"
peft.autocast_adapter_dtype: Whether to autocast the adapter dtype. Defaults to True. Right now, this will only cast adapter weights using float16 or bfloat16 to float32
peft.prepare_model_for_kbit_training: cast all non INT8 parameters to fp32: fp16/bf16 파라미터 중 Params4bit가 아닌 것을 float32로 바꾼다. 기본으로 gradient checkpointing을 켠다(use_gradient_checkpointing=True).

transformers.bnb_replaces: torch.nn.Linear(와 Conv1D)만 bnb.nn.Linear4bit로 바꾼다. nn.Embedding은 바꾸지 않는다.
transformers.not_converted: get_keys_to_not_convert: tied 가중치, 마지막 모듈, 출력 임베딩(lm_head)은 원래 형식으로 둔다("we may want to keep the lm_head in full precision for numerical stability reasons").
transformers.from_pretrained_dtype_default: dtype을 적지 않으면 "auto": config.json의 dtype/torch_dtype(Qwen2.5-7B는 bfloat16)으로 불러온다.

bitsandbytes.paged_quote: Paged optimizers works like regular CPU paging, which means that it only becomes active if you run out of GPU memory.
bitsandbytes.paged_overhead_example: if you evict 1 GB of memory per forward-backward-optimizer loop ... 1 GB for PCIe 3.0 with 16x lanes would run at 16 GB/s, which is 1/(16*0.5) = 1/8 = 125ms of overhead per optimizer step.

from_ch05.t4_bf16: NVIDIA T4 사양 페이지의 지원 정밀도 목록에 BF16이 없다(5장 확인).
